stem: A student is drawing a vertical line segment on the coordinate grid shown. The student starts at point \((-4,-3)\) and extends the line segment 10 units up from the starting point.
instruction: Plot the points on the coordinate grid to show the line segment the student draws. Select two points on the coordinate grid. A line segment will connect the points.
